note: Screened out of data/registers/barcelona-ail.json (Ajuntament de Barcelona, Arbres d'interes local, CC BY 4.0, 208 entries) during the deepening pass that produced data/research/barcelona-extra.json. Not rendered anywhere. leads = trees that failed only on our evidence bar or on the count, and are the raw material if Barcelona grows further. blocked = trees that must never ship whatever happens later, each with its reason. Extended 2026-08-05 by the second deepening pass (data/research/barcelona-extra-2.json, the Montjuic walk): ten leads and five blocked entries added from the Sants-Montjuic screen, and the Lagunaria and the Eritrina of the Teatre Grec removed from leads because they published as bcn_017 and bcn_019. Extended 2026-08-06 by the Barcelona deepen verification pass: the Pedralbes/Torre Girona and Vil.la Amelia clusters (bcn_023 to bcn_032) verified and delivered to data/research/barcelona-verified.json, none blocked. One incidental find (Tarongers de Louisiana, Torre Girona) added to leads, undated and unjudged for collectibility.

leads.name: Freixe de fulla estreta del Jardi Botanic Historic
leads.why: Count, not quality. This and the Acer below are the two remaining trees of the four the Catalan government declared monumental in April 2025, all four in the Sot de l'Estany ravine. We already publish the other two (bcn_005, bcn_006) and the city intro already tells the reader there are four. Adding both would put four of sixteen Barcelona entries inside one ravine behind one paid gate. Strong candidates the day the page can carry them, and the pair completes a claim the page already makes.
leads.register_notes: No planting year recorded. 29 m tall, girth 2.5 m, crown 15 m. Catalogued 2015.

leads.name: Fals platan del Jardi Botanic Historic
leads.why: Same as above: the fourth monumental tree of the Sot de l'Estany, held back on count rather than merit. Register gives no planting year ('Per determinar'), so it would ship flagged.
leads.register_notes: 30 m tall, girth 1.4 m, crown 12 m. Catalogued 2015.

leads.name: Camforer del Jardi Botanic Historic
leads.why: 1933, so 93 years, and a third entry inside the same paid garden. Ownership reads 'Privat' but that is the museum owning the land, not a closed gate, the same as bcn_006. Held on count and age, not access.
leads.register_notes: Sector de la Mediterrania. OSM node 4506730853 confirms the position.

leads.name: Robinia del parc de la Ciutadella
leads.why: A 4.3 m trunk perimeter, which is large for a black locust, but the register's age field reads '100 anys' rather than a year, so there is no date to verify and no second source was found. Catalogued only in 2024, so press coverage may follow.
leads.register_notes: 12 m tall, crown 9 m. Parterre between passeig Joaquim Renart and the Cascada.

leads.name: Platan del parc de la Ciutadella

leads.register_notes: Between the lake and the zoo fence. Catalogued 2021.

leads.name: Pitospor de la Ciutadella
leads.why: No planting year, no recorded height, and a 1.55 m girth on a species that is usually a shrub. Interesting as a curiosity, thin as a page.

leads.name: Araucaria de la casa de la Misericordia
leads.why: 27 m tall in the same courtyard as bcn_010, but the register gives no planting year and no independent source was found. It would also be a second entry on one small Raval courtyard.

leads.name: Platan oriental de la Universitat
leads.why: 1933, so 93 years, on a square rather than in a garden. A true Platanus orientalis rather than the usual London plane hybrid is genuinely uncommon in Spanish cities and this is worth a second look when Barcelona next grows. Would extend the Raval walk east to Placa de la Universitat.
leads.register_notes: 18 m tall, girth 2 m, crown 17 m. Public.

leads.name: Llentiscle de l'Hort de l'Avi, Garrofer del carrer Maignon, Pebrer bord del carrer Maignon, Xiprer comu del carrer Betlem
leads.species: Pistacia lentiscus; Ceratonia siliqua; Schinus molle; Cupressus sempervirens

leads.name: Ficus de Mysore del Santuari de Sant Josep de la Muntanya
leads.why: Undated in the register and access to the sanctuary grounds is unverified. Worth a proper look: it is sacred ground 424 m from the Park Guell cluster, and CLAUDE.md's own step 1 says that is exactly where the unlisted old trees are.

leads.name: Arbres de l'amor de la placa Joanic
leads.why: 1956, 70 years. A Judas tree's April flowering would make a strong best_time, and it is 330 m from bcn_001, but it is too young.

leads.name: The Pedralbes cluster: Jardins del Palau Reial de Pedralbes and Jardins de la Torre Girona
leads.species: Pinus pinea; Cedrus deodara; Tetraclinis articulata; Brachychiton populneus; Maclura pomifera; Pinus halepensis
leads.why: Not evaluated in this pass, and recorded here because it is the strongest untouched cluster in the city. Eight register entries lie inside 400 m of each other across the Palau Reial gardens, the Torre Girona gardens and the Pavellons Guell with Gaudi's dragon gate, all in one walk, 1.2 km west of bcn_007. A future pass should take this as a single unit rather than tree by tree, and must check the access of each: the Palau Reial gardens are public, Torre Girona sits on the UPC campus, and the Pavellons Guell keep visiting hours.
leads.register_notes: OSM nodes 4506752018, 4532330334, 4506742261, 4506743003, 4506753110 confirm several of these positions.

leads.name: The Vil-la Amelia and Sarria cluster
leads.species: Schinus molle; Phoenix canariensis; Platanus x acerifolia; Eucalyptus globulus
leads.why: Four register entries inside one public Sarria garden, 900 m from the Pedralbes cluster above. Not evaluated this pass. The eucalyptus and the plane are single-unit; the palms are a group and would need the collectible-point test.

leads.name: Lledoner de la Fundacio Munoz Ramonet
leads.why: Access unverified. The Munoz Ramonet gardens passed to the city and open to the public on a limited schedule; that needs confirming before this counts as publicly accessible. Undated in the candidate list.

leads.name: Figuera de la Facultat de Dret
leads.why: On the university law faculty grounds. The campus is open in practice but the register does not say so, and the entry is undated. Sits inside the Pedralbes cluster above, so resolve it with that pass.

leads.name: Huingan del carrer Joaquim Blume
leads.why: Species dispute, and it is the only thing holding this back. The city register says Schinus longifolia, an Argentine species; OSM node 4506714524, surveyed from the same catalogue, says Schinus polygamus; and huingan, the common name the city itself uses, is the Chilean name for S. polygama. With the build now failing on species naming, shipping a tree under a contested binomial is not worth it. Everything else is fine: 1916, public, on the Montjuic walk 200 m from the Teatre Grec gardens, and the municipal record calls it a botanical rarity with only one other specimen in the whole city, larger, in the Jardi d'Aclimatacio. Resolve the species with one look at the leaves in a photograph and this ships.
leads.register_notes: Girth 1.6 m, 8 m tall, crown 9 m. Public. Pin would be confirmed: register 41.37211/2.15533 and OSM node 4506714524 are 9 m apart.

leads.name: Araucaria de l'avinguda Francesc Ferrer i Guardia
leads.why: 1920 and 24 m tall, which would make it a good sixth stop on the Montjuic walk, but it has no second source of any kind. It is a recent catalogue entry with no bcnsostenible page, no guia.barcelona page, no OSM node within 400 m and an empty ownership field, so neither the age, the position nor the public access can be corroborated. Everything rests on one line in the open data file.
leads.register_notes: Girth 2 m, 24 m tall, crown 14 m. Ownership field blank.

leads.name: Grevillea dels jardins dels Drets Humans
leads.why: The largest untouched single tree left in the register: girth 4.1 m and 32 m tall, on public ground. Undated, which is the only reason it is here, and it sits 1.4 km south of the botanical garden in La Marina de Port, off the Montjuic walk. A silky oak that size would carry a page on its own if a date or a second source turns up.
leads.register_notes: Crown 27 m. Ownership Public. Jardins dels Drets Humans.

leads.name: Eritrina dels jardins Mossen Costa i Llobera
leads.why: Girth 3 m and a 20 m crown, public, in the free cactus garden on the sea side of Montjuic, which is a real destination in its own right. Undated in the register and no second source found this pass. The obvious anchor for a second Montjuic walk on the Miramar side, together with the Iuca filifera below.

leads.name: Iuca filifera dels jardins de Mossen Costa i Llobera
leads.why: Undated, and a yucca is a marginal call as a collectible tree. Kept because it stands beside the Erythrina caffra above in the same free garden and the pair would make that side of the hill worth a walk.

leads.name: Carpi del jardi Botanic Historic
leads.why: 1924, 20 m tall, in the same ravine as bcn_005, bcn_006, bcn_021 and bcn_022. Ownership reads Privat, which here means the museum owns the land rather than that the gate is shut, the same as bcn_006. Held purely on count: five entries in one quarry pit behind one paid gate is too many.
leads.register_notes: Girth 1.2 m, crown 13 m. Catalogued and mapped as OSM node 6924148786, 20 m from the register coordinate.

leads.name: Alvocater del Teatre Lliure
leads.why: 1946, so 80 years, under the bar. An avocado tree outside a theatre on the Montjuic walk is a good story waiting for the age rule to soften. OSM node 4203274163 confirms the position.

leads.name: Acacia del Japo del carrer Guardia Urbana
leads.why: On the Montjuic walk between the Teatre Grec and Placa Carles Buigas, girth 2.3 m and 20 m tall, but the register's age field reads 'En estudi', under study. No date, no page.

leads.name: Melaleuca dels jardins de Petra Kelly
leads.why: Undated, 4 m tall and a 1.88 m girth, which is a broad low shrub rather than a tree. Recorded for completeness.

leads.name: Lledoner dels jardins dels Drets Humans
leads.why: Girth 2.9 m, public, undated. Sits 130 m from the Grevillea above, so the two would open a small walk in La Marina de Port if either gets a date.

leads.name: Tarongers de Louisiana dels jardins de la Torre Girona
leads.why: Incidental find while verifying the Torre Girona cluster (2026-08-06 Barcelona deepen pass): a 14-unit register entry in the same garden as bcn_026/027/028, but the register gives no planting year and no ownership field, and no independent source was checked this pass. Also a third grove entry in one small garden alongside the pines already delivered, so it would need its own collectibility judgement before it ships.
leads.register_notes: Girth 1.9m, height 8m, crown 6m, catalogued 2021. Age Per determinar in the register.
